visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long reddish-brown hair, wearing a black 'CELINE PARIS' cropped t-shirt and a dark denim-like skirt, stands in a brightly lit office corridor with grey walls and lime green panels. She gestures with her hands while speaking to the camera. (2) She turns around, places her heels against the wall, steps back two foot-lengths, then leans forward with her head against the wall. She attempts to lift a large black cylindrical ottoman, succeeds, and runs down the hall laughing. (3) A young man with blonde hair and a denim-styled shirt takes his turn. He performs the same routine with a smaller white stool, lifting it easily and smiling at the camera as he stands up. (4) A man in a black and white horizontal striped sweater attempts the challenge. He bends over with his head against the wall but is unable to lift the white stool, showing physical strain and frustration. (5) A third man in a black short-sleeved shirt tries the challenge. He grips the white stool tightly but fails to lift it while keeping his head against the wall, leading to laughter from onlookers. (6) A young woman in a white knitted long-sleeve crop top and black shorts tries next. She lifts the white stool effortlessly and stands upright, laughing with the group. (7) Another woman in a white t-shirt and jeans performs the challenge, lifting the stool quickly and easily before moving out of the frame. (8) A man in a dark denim jacket attempts the lift but remains stuck in the bent position, unable to move the stool. (9) A woman with long red hair wearing a plaid top and jeans lifts the stool with no apparent effort. (10) The blonde man from the third phase returns to the center of the frame, speaking directly to the camera with promotional text overlays appearing around him.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A female voice speaks with high energy over an upbeat electronic dance track. Background laughter and chatter from a small group are audible. (2) Sudden impact sound effect as a heavy object is moved. A viral 'marmot scream' meme sound effect is triggered at a high volume, followed by erupting laughter. (3) Continuous rhythmic BGM at roughly 128 BPM plays under the chatter. Multiple male and female voices react with 'Whoa' and 'Oh' sounds as people succeed or fail the task. (4) Distinct vocal tension and straining grunts from male speakers are heard as they try to lift the stool. Sound effects like 'ding' and comedic slide whistles are used for emphasis. (5) The BGM continues seamlessly as the environment transitions to more structured talking. (6) The final section features a clear, melodic male vocal track (singing) blended with a spoken outro by the same male, promoting a new song in a warm, professional tone.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To participate in a viral internet challenge (the gender-based center-of-gravity lift test) to generate engagement and provide a platform for promoting the male artist's new single.
